sentences.zh: 泳池就是泳池。

sentences.en: And we'll do it like a pool.
sentences.zh: 我们会把它当成泳池来处理。

sentences.en: And that was what President Trump said several times in public.
sentences.zh: 这就是特朗普总统在公开场合多次说过的话。

sentences.en: It turns out that's not true.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，那不是真的。

sentences.en: As far as I can tell, this company advertises no experience doing swimming pools.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，这家公司从未宣传过自己有建造游泳池的经验。

sentences.en: There are experiences in things like coding, highway culverts, fuel tanks, waterproofing things, but not swimming pools.
sentences.zh: 他们有编程、公路涵洞、燃料箱、防水工程等方面的经验，但没有泳池方面的经验。

sentences.en: And I also don't think they've ever worked for the Trump organization.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他们也从未为特朗普集团工作过。

sentences.en: And now Trump himself has said as much.
sentences.zh: 现在特朗普本人也这么说了。

sentences.en: He said, I don't know this company and they never worked for me.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不认识这家公司，他们也从未为我工作过。

sentences.en: Raising again the question of how they got this job.
sentences.zh: 这再次引发了关于他们是如何得到这份工作的疑问。

sentences.en: It's odd that this company, which doesn't have any advertised experience doing even small swimming pools,
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，这家连小型泳池施工经验都没有宣传过的公司，

sentences.en: would be entrusted by the government without any sort of competitive bidding process.
sentences.zh: 竟然在没有任何竞争性招标程序的情况下，被政府委以重任。

sentences.en: But that is what happened.
sentences.zh: 但事实确实如此。

sentences.en: And this is this company's first time doing work for the federal government?
sentences.zh: 而且这是这家公司第一次为联邦政府工作？

sentences.en: This is their first ever federal contract.
sentences.zh: 这是他们有史以来第一个联邦合同。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It's a pretty big stage to make a debut on.
sentences.zh: 这可是个相当大的首秀舞台。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what is the scope of work that this company is undertaking here to get this thing fully functioning by the 250th anniversary?
sentences.zh: 那么这家公司为了在250周年纪念日前让这里完全恢复功能，承担的工作范围是什么？

sentences.en: Well, we can see that work in front of us.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们可以看到眼前的这些工作。

sentences.en: So one of the things they're doing is spreading a waterproofing compound on the 8-inch concrete slabs.
sentences.zh: 他们正在做的一件事是在8英寸厚的混凝土板上涂抹防水化合物。

sentences.en: They're also filling in the gaps or trying to fill in the gaps between the concrete slabs.
sentences.zh: 他们还在填补混凝土板之间的缝隙，或者说试图填补这些缝隙。

sentences.en: So that's supposed to address the leaks?
sentences.zh: 所以那是为了解决渗漏问题？

sentences.en: The leaks.
sentences.zh: 渗漏问题。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: To understand, though, why that was such a risk, I think you need to know a little bit more about why the pool has been troublesome and why it needs repair.
sentences.zh: 不过，要理解为什么这风险这么大，我认为你需要多了解一点为什么这个泳池一直是个麻烦，以及为什么它需要维修。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So President Trump, in his first term, started thinking about, how do I fix the problems of the reflecting pool?
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在第一个任期内就开始考虑，我该如何解决倒影池的问题？

sentences.en: And what we're seeing now is that in his second term, he's actually trying to make those repairs happen.
sentences.zh: 而我们现在看到的是，在他的第二个任期内，他确实在试图落实这些维修工作。

sentences.en: Well, here's what's odd about what the Trump administration is doing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，特朗普政府的做法有些奇怪。

sentences.en: They are doing two of the three things that needed to be done before.
sentences.zh: 他们正在做之前需要完成的三件事中的两件。

sentences.en: They're trying to fix the leaky joints between the concrete slabs.
sentences.zh: 他们试图修复混凝土板之间渗漏的接缝。

sentences.en: Another contract, not done by this company, is putting a new filtration system in.
sentences.zh: 另一个合同，不是由这家公司完成的，正在安装新的过滤系统。

sentences.en: But they're not doing one key piece, which is they're not fixing the pipes that connect the pool with that filtration system.
sentences.zh: 但他们没有做关键的一步，那就是没有修复连接泳池和过滤系统的管道。

sentences.en: And if those don't get fixed and they continue to leak, then the allergy problem could recur because you're not getting the water to the place where it's clean.
sentences.zh: 如果那些管道不修复并持续渗漏，那么藻类问题可能会复发，因为水无法被输送到清洁的地方。

sentences.en: And why wouldn't you just fix this root to stem, fix the pipes, permanently restore this pool?
sentences.zh: 为什么不从根源到末端彻底修复，修好管道，永久性地恢复这个泳池呢？

sentences.en: It's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是个好问题。

sentences.en: That was the plan.
sentences.zh: 那原本是计划。

sentences.en: Starting in the first Trump administration through Biden, the plan was to do all three of those things.
sentences.zh: 从特朗普第一任期开始到拜登时期，计划都是要做这三件事。

sentences.en: Seal the pool, fix the pipes, fix the filtration.
sentences.zh: 密封泳池，修复管道，修复过滤系统。

sentences.en: Somewhere this year, the fix the pipes thing got put on the shelf.
sentences.zh: 今年某个时候，修复管道的事被搁置了。

sentences.en: They say now they might do it in the fall, but it's not happening now.
sentences.zh: 他们现在说可能在秋天做，但现在还没动静。

sentences.en: And until that gets done, what people we've talked to said, it's not a permanent fix.
sentences.zh: 我们采访的人说，在这些完成之前，这都不是永久性的修复。

sentences.en: And we see in Park Service documents that the Park Service says, you know, our own people didn't come up with this plan to fix the pool.
sentences.zh: 我们在公园管理局的文件中看到，公园管理局说，你知道，我们自己的人并没有提出这个修复泳池的计划。

sentences.en: The person who came up with it is a guy named David S., an administration advisor.
sentences.zh: 提出这个计划的人是一个叫大卫·S的人，他是政府的一名顾问。

sentences.en: Who is David S.?
sentences.zh: 大卫·S是谁？

sentences.en: If you look in other documents related to this contract, you see that a guy named David Schutzenhofer, who's the general manager of Trump's golf course in Bedminster, New Jersey,
sentences.zh: 如果你查看与此合同相关的其他文件，你会发现一个叫大卫·舒岑霍夫的人，他是特朗普在新泽西州贝德明斯特高尔夫球场的总经理，

sentences.en: was advising the Park Service on this job, was helping connect them with other vendors.
sentences.zh: 他一直在为公园管理局提供这项工作的建议，并帮助他们联系其他供应商。

sentences.en: We don't know for sure that he is the same David S., but you see that the origins of this whole idea, the whole plan for fixing this pool, have come from outside the Park Service.
sentences.zh: 我们不能确定他就是那个大卫·S，但你可以看出，整个想法的起源，即修复这个泳池的整个计划，都是来自公园管理局之外。

sentences.en: And it was an idea they hadn't even considered before.
sentences.zh: 而且这是一个他们之前甚至从未考虑过的想法。

sentences.en: So that gives you a sense of how kind of out of the box this solution is.
sentences.zh: 所以这让你感觉到这个解决方案是多么的非同寻常。

sentences.en: What is the price tag that this company is charging all of us to do this work?
sentences.zh: 这家公司向我们所有人收取多少费用来做这项工作？

sentences.en: It's charging right now $13.1 million.
sentences.zh: 目前收费是1310万美元。

sentences.en: That is notable because it's also different than President Trump first described.
sentences.zh: 这很值得注意，因为它也与特朗普总统最初描述的不同。

sentences.en: He originally said this contract would cost $1.8 million.
sentences.zh: 他最初说这份合同将耗资180万美元。

sentences.en: It's now obviously seven times that.
sentences.zh: 现在显然是那时的七倍。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And do we know why?
sentences.zh: 我们知道原因吗？

sentences.en: This contract is as large as it is, in part because the company is charging 20% for overhead and then 20% more for profit.
sentences.zh: 这份合同之所以这么大，部分原因是该公司收取20%的管理费，然后再加20%的利润。

sentences.en: Now, we've seen Park Service documents that show that even within the Park Service, people believe that those two percentages, 20% and 20%, were excessive and inflated.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们看到的公园管理局文件显示，即使在公园管理局内部，人们也认为这两个百分比，即20%和20%，是过高且虚报的。

sentences.en: The Park Service is paying them anyway, in part because they're on a very quick timeline.
sentences.zh: 公园管理局还是付了钱，部分原因是他们的时间表非常紧迫。

sentences.en: The government wanted this work done so badly that it actually told them to start work before they'd agreed on a price tag.
sentences.zh: 政府非常希望完成这项工作，以至于在还没谈妥价格的情况下就让他们开工了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so that means that later on when they came to haggle over the final price, the pool was already partly underway.
sentences.zh: 这意味着后来当他们讨价还价最终价格时，泳池工程已经进行了一部分。

sentences.en: The government has very little leverage to come back then and say, hey, listen, we're not going to pay the full price.
sentences.zh: 政府那时几乎没有什么筹码回头说，嘿，听着，我们不会付全价的。

sentences.en: Like, you know, would they really threaten to kick them off, you know, with the work partly done?
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，他们真的会威胁要把他们踢走吗，在工作已经进行了一部分的情况下？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And with everyone understanding that the president wants to get this thing ready for 250th, which means we really only have a couple months left.
sentences.zh: 而且大家都明白总统想让这东西为250周年纪念日做好准备，这意味着我们真的只剩下几个月了。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The original due date for this project was May 22nd.
sentences.zh: 这个项目的最初截止日期是5月22日。

sentences.en: Now President Trump is saying the real deadline is July 4th.
sentences.zh: 现在特朗普总统说真正的截止日期是7月4日。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Which I think brings me to the final issue with the reflecting pool, which is the president's selection of a very specific shade of blue, which I am looking at.
sentences.zh: 这让我想到了倒影池的最后一个问题，那就是总统选择了一种非常特殊的蓝色，我正在看。

sentences.en: And I just want to ask you about it.
sentences.zh: 我想问你一下。

sentences.en: Well, a lot of the pool's bottom is painted a dark shade of blue.
sentences.zh: 嗯，泳池底部大部分被漆成了深蓝色。

sentences.en: President Trump said that he had originally wanted it to be turquoise, like the Bahamas,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统说他最初想要的是绿松石色，像巴哈马群岛那样，

sentences.en: but that the contractor that he had hired for this told him that it should be American flag blue.
sentences.zh: 但他雇佣的承包商告诉他应该是美国国旗蓝。

sentences.en: And so American flag blue is what they've settled on.
sentences.zh: 所以他们最终确定了美国国旗蓝。

sentences.en: Kind of a deep navy blue.
sentences.zh: 一种深海军蓝。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a dark kind of blue, dark blue-jean blue.
sentences.zh: 是的，是一种深蓝色，深牛仔蓝。

sentences.en: That is the color now of most of the pool.
sentences.zh: 这就是现在泳池大部分的颜色。

sentences.en: It will be the final color of the entire pool.
sentences.zh: 这将是整个泳池最终的颜色。

sentences.en: And the question is, what will it look like when it is filled?
sentences.zh: 问题是，当它注满水后会是什么样子？

sentences.en: People that I've talked to, landscape architecture experts, say that it probably will not affect the reflectivity.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的人，景观建筑专家，说这可能不会影响反射效果。

sentences.en: What makes it reflective is that it's shallow and it's dark.
sentences.zh: 它之所以能反射是因为它很浅而且颜色很深。

sentences.en: And it will still have both of those elements.
sentences.zh: 它仍然会具备这两个要素。

sentences.en: So in the end, when it comes to the reflecting pool, we have a project that's not going to solve what may be all the big underlying probleMs.
sentences.zh: 所以最后，说到倒影池，我们有一个项目，它并不能解决所有潜在的重大问题。

sentences.en: And because the administration granted this to a single company and didn't put it out for any competitive bidding process, we don't know if somebody might have come along and said,
sentences.zh: 而且因为政府把这个项目授予了一家公司，没有进行任何竞争性招标，我们不知道是否有人会站出来说，

sentences.en: actually, I can do it for less than $13 million.
sentences.zh: 其实，我可以用不到1300万美元的价格完成它。

sentences.en: We'll never know that because of the way that this contract was awarded.
sentences.zh: 我们永远不会知道，因为这个合同的授予方式。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This case really embodies the risks of no-bid contracts, right?
sentences.zh: 这个案例真正体现了无招标合同的风险，对吧？

sentences.en: Without knowing what other people would charge, without knowing how other people would have attacked these same problems,
sentences.zh: 在不知道其他人会收多少钱，不知道其他人会如何解决这些同样的问题的情况下，

sentences.en: it's really hard to know if what they have here is the right solution, the best solution, the cheapest solution.
sentences.zh: 真的很难知道他们这里所做的方案是否是正确的、最好的、最便宜的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's impossible to evaluate what else could have been done.
sentences.zh: 不可能评估还能做些什么。

sentences.en: We only know what they have.
sentences.zh: 我们只知道他们现在做的这些。

sentences.en: All right, Dave, we have one last stop on this tour, and that is the arch.
sentences.zh: 好了，戴夫，我们这次参观的最后一站是凯旋门。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We're now going to walk west to the Lincoln Memorial to look across the Potomac River at the future site of the Triumphal Arch.
sentences.zh: 我们现在要向西走到林肯纪念堂，隔着波托马克河眺望凯旋门的未来选址。

sentences.en: The United States Triumphal Arch.
sentences.zh: 美国凯旋门。

sentences.en: The Lincoln Memorial, right over there.
sentences.zh: 林肯纪念堂，就在那边。

sentences.en: This is by far my favorite.
sentences.zh: 这是我最喜欢的地方。

sentences.en: I think it's everyone's favorite.
sentences.zh: 我想这是大家的最爱。

sentences.en: Yeah, mine as well.
sentences.zh: 是的，我也是。

sentences.en: Monument on the Mall.
sentences.zh: 国家广场上的纪念碑。

sentences.en: Because it's something spectacular about going into his little home.
sentences.zh: 因为走进他的小家有一种壮观的感觉。

sentences.en: Right, it is grand and also intimate when you get inside there.
sentences.zh: 没错，当你走进里面时，它既宏伟又亲切。

sentences.en: Should we just go to this little, like, patch of green here?
sentences.zh: 我们要去这片小草地吗？

sentences.en: Or do you want to go across the bridge?
sentences.zh: 还是你想过桥？

sentences.en: I'm happy to do either one.
sentences.zh: 我都可以。

sentences.en: Can we stand up on this?
sentences.zh: 我们能站在这上面吗？

sentences.en: I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 我不这么认为。

sentences.en: I don't think there's any problem with that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这没什么问题。

sentences.en: What a car!
sentences.zh: 好车！

sentences.en: So, David, we just scaled the wall, and now we're sitting on a patch of grass behind the
sentences.zh: 所以，大卫，我们刚翻过墙，现在坐在林肯纪念堂后面的一片草地上，

sentences.en: Lincoln Memorial, and we've picked an incredible moment to have a conversation about the arch.
sentences.zh: 我们选了一个绝佳的时刻来谈论凯旋门。

sentences.en: Let me explain why.
sentences.zh: 让我解释一下原因。

sentences.en: There is currently a protest, a group of people marching against the arch.
sentences.zh: 目前有一场抗议活动，一群人正在游行反对凯旋门。

sentences.en: They have handwritten signs saying no arch.
sentences.zh: 他们手写的标语上写着不要凯旋门。

sentences.en: They have a tuba.
sentences.zh: 他们有一个大号。

sentences.en: There's a band in there.
sentences.zh: 里面有个乐队。

sentences.en: There are people beeping, and that volume is on top of all the traffic and the planes going overhead.
sentences.zh: 有人在鸣笛，那声音盖过了所有的交通声和头顶飞过的飞机声。

sentences.en: So, just explain to us, as we're looking down at the Arlington Memorial Bridge, how the arch
sentences.zh: 所以，请向我们解释一下，当我们俯瞰阿灵顿纪念大桥时，凯旋门

sentences.en: is going to fit into the view that we're taking in right now, and what you've learned about the process behind the arch so far.
sentences.zh: 将如何融入我们现在的视野，以及你到目前为止对凯旋门背后的过程了解到了什么。

sentences.en: Well, what we're looking at now, across the other end of the bridge, is a green hillside in Virginia that belongs to Arlington National Cemetery.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们现在看到的，在大桥的另一端，是弗吉尼亚州的一片绿山坡，属于阿灵顿国家公墓。

sentences.en: Instead, with the arches completed, you will see a very large, 250-foot-tall, that's 25-story-tall
sentences.zh: 相反，凯旋门建成后，你将看到一个非常巨大的、250英尺高，也就是25层楼高的

sentences.en: triumphal arch, which is a little bit like the Arc de Triomphe in Paris, but bigger, and it will have golden statues.
sentences.zh: 凯旋门，它有点像巴黎的凯旋门，但更大，而且会有金色的雕像。

sentences.en: I believe there'll be angels and eagles.
sentences.zh: 我相信会有天使和老鹰。

sentences.en: It'll be a really large arch dominating this view.
sentences.zh: 这将是一个巨大的凯旋门，主导着这个视野。

sentences.en: It's got to be the biggest new construction in this kind of official stretch of Washington in decades.
sentences.zh: 这一定是几十年来华盛顿官方区域内最大的新建工程。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It will be something on the scale of or bigger than the Lincoln Memorial.
sentences.zh: 它的规模将与林肯纪念堂相当或更大。

sentences.en: We haven't built anything that large as a monument on the mall in, as you said, decades.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，几十年来我们没有在国家广场上建造过如此巨大的纪念碑。

sentences.en: And how has the president gotten the arch to this point, and how emblematic is it of what we just saw at Lafayette and with the Reflecting Pool?
sentences.zh: 总统是如何让凯旋门走到这一步的？它与我们在拉斐特公园和倒影池看到的情况有多大的象征意义？

sentences.en: Well, there hasn't been any contracts assigned yet, so we don't know if there's going to be no-bid contracts or not.
sentences.zh: 嗯，目前还没有签署任何合同，所以我们不知道是否会有无招标合同。

sentences.en: But it is of a similar vein in that he is trying as much as he can to avoid or bypass outside oversight.
sentences.zh: 但它有着相似的脉络，因为他正在尽其所能避免或绕过外部监督。

sentences.en: So even to Congress, he's made the point to Congress that normally they would have to approve something this large in Washington's monumental core.
sentences.zh: 所以即使是对国会，他也向国会指出，通常他们必须批准华盛顿纪念核心区如此巨大的项目。

sentences.en: But he said they don't need to because 100 years ago, another Congress approved a sort of similar-sounding project that was never built, and so it already has congressional
sentences.zh: 但他表示他们不需要，因为100年前，另一届国会批准了一个听起来类似的项目，但从未建成，所以它已经有了国会的

sentences.en: approval.
sentences.zh: 批准。

sentences.en: That's extremely creative.
sentences.zh: 这非常有创意。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It is similar to the other projects in that they are going as fast as they can to build something as big as they can.
sentences.zh: 它和其他项目类似，都在尽可能快地建造尽可能宏大的东西。

sentences.en: And what kind of opposition has or hasn't it aroused, besides the honking horns here on the road?
sentences.zh: 除了路上这些鸣笛声，它还引起了什么样的反对或支持吗？

sentences.en: There are a lot of people in Washington unhappy about it.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿有很多人对此感到不满。

sentences.en: There have been some lawsuits filed.
sentences.zh: 已经提起了一些诉讼。

sentences.en: There are people who would like to stop this in its tracks.
sentences.zh: 有些人希望能彻底阻止它。

sentences.en: A group of veterans have sued, saying that this disrupts the view of Arlington Cemetery, but none of them have succeeded so far.
sentences.zh: 一群退伍军人提起诉讼，称这破坏了阿灵顿公墓的景观，但到目前为止，他们都没有成功。

sentences.en: There have been some incremental changes as a result of some of the review boards that have considered it.
sentences.zh: 在一些审查委员会对其进行审议后，它确实发生了一些渐进式的变化。

sentences.en: It's gotten slightly shorter.
sentences.zh: 它稍微变矮了一些。

sentences.en: I believe some of the lions have come off.
sentences.zh: 我想有些狮子雕像已经被移除了。

sentences.en: But the fundamental shape of it is still, for now, the same.
sentences.zh: 但它的基本形状目前看来还是没变。

sentences.en: The noise we're hearing from the planes is a reminder of one of the big hurdles laying in front of it, which is actually that this is on the flight path, the approach to
sentences.zh: 我们听到的飞机噪音提醒了我们它面临的一大障碍，实际上它正处于华盛顿国家机场的航线上，是进场航道，

sentences.en: Washington National Airport, and there is a concern that the FAA might block it because it will be too much of a constriction on air traffic.
sentences.zh: 人们担心联邦航空管理局可能会阻止它，因为它会对空中交通造成过大的限制。

sentences.en: So there are some hurdles in front of it, but if I had to bet, I would bet that it's going to be built.
sentences.zh: 所以它面前确实有一些障碍，但如果非要我打赌，我会赌它最终会被建成。

sentences.en: Well, we talked before about sight lines, and I do think it's worth just spending a second on what this arch would change.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们之前谈到了视线问题，我觉得值得花点时间谈谈这座拱门会带来什么改变。

sentences.en: Because there are some really specific structures on the hill behind the Arlington Memorial Bridge that relate to the Civil War, right?
sentences.zh: 因为在阿灵顿纪念大桥后面的山上，有一些与内战相关的非常特殊的建筑，对吧？

sentences.en: Relate back to the Lincoln Memorial and all these kind of reciprocal relationships between the historical monuments of Washington.
sentences.zh: 它们与林肯纪念堂以及华盛顿历史古迹之间所有这些相互关联的关系有关。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So if you'll indulge me as a transplanted Washingtonian, I think this is one of the most remarkable places in Washington.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果允许我这个移居华盛顿的人发表一点看法，我认为这是华盛顿最引人注目的地方之一。

sentences.en: So we're standing here by the Lincoln Memorial, a symbol of the rebinding of North and South.
sentences.zh: 我们现在站在林肯纪念堂旁，这是南北重归于好的象征。

sentences.en: So what's beyond us on the other side of the bridge is Arlington House, which belonged to Robert E.
sentences.zh: 桥的另一边是阿灵顿故居，它曾属于罗伯特·E·

sentences.en: Lee.
sentences.zh: 李。

sentences.en: It was Robert E.
sentences.zh: 这是罗伯特·E·

sentences.en: Lee's home before he left to become the leader, the top general of the
sentences.zh: 李在离开去担任南方邦联最高将领之前的家。

sentences.en: Confederacy.
sentences.zh: 邦联。

sentences.en: A bridge between the home of the man who tried to tear the Union asunder and the president who, through grit and determination, made sure that the country stayed whole.
sentences.zh: 这是一座桥梁，连接着试图分裂联邦的人的故居，和那位凭借坚韧和决心确保国家保持完整的总统。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the graves of the folks who died to win that war.
sentences.zh: 还有那些为赢得那场战争而牺牲的人们的墓地。

sentences.en: And so if you're going to block that, right, if you're going to put something in between these two symbols of the greatest crisis in American history and the reconciliation that
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你要阻挡它，对吧，如果你要在美国历史上最严重的危机及其随后的和解这两个象征之间放置某种东西，

sentences.en: followed, you better have a really good reason, right?
sentences.zh: 你最好有一个非常充分的理由，对吧？

sentences.en: It better really mean something that you're putting that there and blocking the view of
sentences.zh: 你放置那个东西并阻挡了对这块美国历史瑰宝的视野，它最好真的有某种意义，

sentences.en: this incredible piece of American history that's just right across the river from Washington.
sentences.zh: 这块瑰宝就在华盛顿河对岸。

sentences.en: And what is the reason why the president wants to put this arch here at this moment?
sentences.zh: 那么总统此时想要在这里放置这座拱门的理由是什么呢？

sentences.en: And as best I can tell, and Times 3D renderings does show this, it substantially does change
sentences.zh: 据我所知，而且《泰晤士报》的3D渲染图也显示了这一点，它确实在很大程度上改变了

sentences.en: the view, especially from Arlington House, from Arlington Cemetery, back towards the Lincoln
sentences.zh: 视野，特别是从阿灵顿故居、从阿灵顿公墓向回望向林肯

sentences.en: Memorial.
sentences.zh: 纪念堂的视野。

sentences.en: My reading of it is that he wants an arch.
sentences.zh: 我的解读是，他想要一座拱门。

sentences.en: He's talked about how all great cities have arches, London, Paris, Rome.
sentences.zh: 他谈到过所有伟大的城市都有拱门，比如伦敦、巴黎、罗马。

sentences.en: And so Washington needs one.
sentences.zh: 所以华盛顿也需要一个。

sentences.en: And this is the easiest place to put an arch because it's a big, empty lawn around which traffic flows.
sentences.zh: 而这是放置拱门最容易的地方，因为它是一片巨大的空草坪，周围是车流。

sentences.en: What President Trump says this arch is meant to celebrate is all of us, the 250 years of
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统说这座拱门旨在庆祝我们所有人，庆祝250年的

sentences.en: American history.
sentences.zh: 美国历史。

sentences.en: But it seems in some ways to be more a monument to President Trump and his importance in American history.
sentences.zh: 但在某些方面，它似乎更像是特朗普总统及其在美国历史上重要性的纪念碑。

sentences.en: To the degree that there's any singular person or cause associated with this arch, it's him.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么特定的人或事业与这座拱门相关，那就是他。

sentences.en: And it strikes me that any change to the official Washington infrastructure makes people crazy.
sentences.zh: 我发现，对华盛顿官方基础设施的任何改变都会让人们抓狂。

sentences.en: And I'm remembering the battle that preceded the construction of the World War II Memorial, which we walked through on our way to the reflecting pool.
sentences.zh: 我记得二战纪念碑建设前的那场争论，我们在去倒影池的路上经过了那里。

sentences.en: It was the late 1990s.
sentences.zh: 那是90年代末。

sentences.en: I was in high school.
sentences.zh: 我当时在上高中。

sentences.en: There was a huge fight about whether that memorial was going to muck up the National Mall.
sentences.zh: 关于那座纪念碑是否会破坏国家广场，曾有过一场巨大的争论。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it got built.
sentences.zh: 但它还是建成了。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Despite that huge battle.
sentences.zh: 尽管有那场巨大的争论。

sentences.en: And now, no one thinks twice about it.
sentences.zh: 现在，没人会再多想它了。

sentences.en: You walk through it.
sentences.zh: 你走过它。

sentences.en: It's just not that big a deal.
sentences.zh: 这根本没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: And you kind of can't imagine that there was ever a big battle over it at all.
sentences.zh: 你甚至无法想象它曾经引发过一场大争论。

sentences.en: And I wonder if that's ultimately going to be the case with the arch.
sentences.zh: 我想知道最终这座拱门会不会也是这样。

sentences.en: Yes, it's going to deprive someone standing at the Arlington House of a very specific view back to the Lincoln Memorial.
sentences.zh: 是的，它会剥夺站在阿灵顿故居的人回望林肯纪念堂的特定视野。

sentences.en: But is that really such a big deal?
sentences.zh: 但这真的有那么重要吗？

sentences.en: And will people walk under it, drive under it, and ultimately not think that much about or be grateful for the fact that there's this bold, beautiful arch at the end of the mall?
sentences.zh: 人们会不会从它下面走过、开车经过，最终觉得这没什么，或者反而会因为广场尽头有这样一座宏伟、美丽的拱门而感到高兴呢？

sentences.en: I think you are right that if it is built within a few years, everybody will think of it as part of the scenery in Washington.
sentences.zh: 我认为你说得对，如果它在几年内建成，每个人都会把它视为华盛顿风景的一部分。

sentences.en: Nobody will walk by and say, you know, it doesn't belong.
sentences.zh: 没人会走过时说，你知道，它不属于这里。

sentences.en: It is the same architectural style as the rest of Washington.
sentences.zh: 它的建筑风格与华盛顿其他地方是一样的。

sentences.en: And so it will stand out for its size, but not for its architecture.
sentences.zh: 所以它会因其规模而引人注目，而不是因为它的建筑风格。

sentences.en: The one thing that I think is different from the other monuments that have caused consternation in Washington over the years,
sentences.zh: 我认为它与多年来在华盛顿引起恐慌的其他纪念碑有一点不同，

sentences.en: and I think of not just the World War II Memorial, but the very modernist Vietnam War Memorial before that,
sentences.zh: 我指的不仅是二战纪念碑，还有在此之前非常现代主义的越战纪念碑，

sentences.en: is that those other monuments were monuments to a group of people, people who had sacrificed something.
sentences.zh: 那些纪念碑是为了纪念一群人，一群做出过牺牲的人。

sentences.en: But what's slightly different about this is that there's not like one set of people this is designed to honor,
sentences.zh: 但这个项目稍微有点不同的是，它并不是为了纪念某一群人，

sentences.en: or one set of people who will come here and feel like, yes, I have my place in Washington that I didn't have before.
sentences.zh: 也不是为了让某一群人来到这里时觉得，是的，我在华盛顿有了以前没有的位置。

sentences.en: It's either totally abstract or it's about Trump.
sentences.zh: 它要么是完全抽象的，要么就是关于特朗普的。

sentences.en: Okay, but, and this is a really big but, if we look all around us, left, right, front, back, there are monuments to American presidents all around us.
sentences.zh: 好吧，但是——这是一个非常大的“但是”——如果我们环顾四周，左边、右边、前面、后面，到处都是美国总统的纪念碑。

sentences.en: We've talked about Lincoln, we've talked about Washington, over there to my left is Jefferson.
sentences.zh: 我们谈到了林肯，谈到了华盛顿，在我左边那边是杰斐逊。

sentences.en: So in that context, why shouldn't President Trump get what we kind of understand to be a memorial to himself,
sentences.zh: 那么在那种背景下，为什么特朗普总统不能得到我们所理解的属于他自己的纪念碑呢？

sentences.en: given how monumentally he has changed American politics, American policy, how the world thinks about America?
sentences.zh: 考虑到他以如此巨大的方式改变了美国政治、美国政策，以及世界对美国的看法？

sentences.en: Well, traditionally, we have not let presidents build their own memorials.
sentences.zh: 嗯，按照传统，我们不会让总统建造他们自己的纪念碑。

sentences.en: Traditionally, you have to leave office, there has to be some sort of intervening period in which Americans
sentences.zh: 按照传统，你必须离任，必须有一段中间期，让美国人

sentences.en: and American history can judge your time in office and decide whether you are worthy of a monumental tribute.
sentences.zh: 和美国历史来评判你的任期，并决定你是否值得拥有这种宏大的致敬。

sentences.en: Right, and how that monument relates to the way we think of you.
sentences.zh: 没错，还有这座纪念碑如何与我们对你的看法相关联。

sentences.en: Right, we don't give every president, there's not a Grover Cleveland monument around here, right?
sentences.zh: 没错，我们不会给每一位总统都立碑，这附近没有格罗弗·克利夫兰的纪念碑，对吧？

sentences.en: We give presidents that we decide are worthy of emulation and adoration, we give them a place here in Washington.
sentences.zh: 我们只为那些我们认为值得效仿和崇拜的总统在华盛顿留出一席之地。

sentences.en: And Trump has decided to give himself that place, effectively, and that is very emblematic of who he's been,
sentences.zh: 而特朗普决定给自己留出那个位置，这实际上非常象征着他一直以来的为人，

sentences.en: all the ways he's discarded the so-called rules of politics, but also the real rules of Washington and succeeded and put his stamp on the country and the world.
sentences.zh: 他抛弃了所谓的政治规则，也抛弃了华盛顿的真正规则，并取得了成功，在国家和世界上留下了自己的印记。

sentences.en: So in that way, having Trump build his own memorial is very fitting.
sentences.zh: 所以从这个角度来看，让特朗普建造他自己的纪念碑是非常合适的。

sentences.en: That said, you can't seal your place in history and trust that it will stay that way.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，你无法锁定你在历史上的地位，并确信它会一直保持下去。

sentences.en: American history will still render some judgment on Trump.
sentences.zh: 美国历史仍将对特朗普做出某种评判。

sentences.en: You can't just build a monument and forestall that.
sentences.zh: 你不能仅仅通过建造一座纪念碑来阻止这一点。

sentences.en: But he is certainly trying to make sure that he can't be forgotten.
sentences.zh: 但他确实在努力确保自己不会被遗忘。

sentences.en: Well, David, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: After we spoke with David, congressional Democrats introduced legislation seeking to block construction of the arch.
sentences.zh: 在大卫发言后，国会民主党人提出了旨在阻止拱门建设的立法。

sentences.en: Their bill claims that the arch relies on illegal use of public funds without permission from Congress.
sentences.zh: 他们的法案声称，该拱门依赖于未经国会许可而非法使用公共资金。

sentences.en: The bill, which is considered a long shot, is co-sponsored by Representative Don Byers of Northern Virginia,
sentences.zh: 该法案被认为成功的可能性很小，由北弗吉尼亚州的众议员唐·拜尔共同发起，

sentences.en: whose district includes Arlington National Cemetery, and whose grandparents, parents, and sister are buried there.
sentences.zh: 他的选区包括阿灵顿国家公墓，他的祖父母、父母和姐妹都安葬在那里。

sentences.en: This is one of our country's most hallowed spaces.
sentences.zh: 这是我们国家最神圣的空间之一。

sentences.en: In a video recorded in front of the cemetery, Byers described the arch as an act of desecration.
sentences.zh: 在公墓前录制的一段视频中，拜尔将这座拱门描述为一种亵渎行为。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, those of us who treasure it are reckoning with a threat to the peace of this sacred place and to the honor and trust it represents.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我们这些珍视它的人正在面对一种威胁，它威胁到了这个神圣地方的宁静，以及它所代表的荣誉和信任。

sentences.en: A towering, 250-foot vanity project that would overshadow the resting place of our heroes and hide it from the view of visitors to the National Mall and Lincoln Memorial.
sentences.zh: 一个高达250英尺的虚荣项目，它将遮蔽我们英雄的安息之地，并将其从国家广场和林肯纪念堂游客的视野中隐藏起来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The future of President Trump's controversial $1.8 billion fund to compensate victims of government weaponization
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统那项备受争议的18亿美元基金，旨在赔偿政府武器化受害者，

sentences.en: is in growing doubt after decisions on Friday from two federal judges.
sentences.zh: 在周五两名联邦法官做出裁决后，其未来正面临越来越多的质疑。

sentences.en: One judge temporarily barred the fund from being set up, while another reopened a legal case involving Trump and the IRS, whose dismissal appeared to lead to the fund's creation.
sentences.zh: 一位法官暂时禁止设立该基金，而另一位法官则重启了一起涉及特朗普和国税局的法律案件，该案的驳回似乎导致了该基金的设立。

sentences.en: At the same time, aides to the president are increasingly urging him to get rid of the fund, amid intense blowback from both courts and from Congress.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在法院和国会的强烈反对下，总统的助手们正越来越多地敦促他取消该基金。

sentences.en: And a cornerstone of the president's plan to celebrate America's 250th anniversary, a series of musical concerts on the National Mall starting later this month, is collapsing.
sentences.zh: 而总统庆祝美国建国250周年计划的基石——一系列定于本月晚些时候在国家广场举行的音乐会——正在瓦解。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, Trump called for the music series to be canceled after at least five of the nine performers dropped out.
sentences.zh: 周末，在九名表演者中至少有五人退出后，特朗普呼吁取消该音乐系列活动。

sentences.en: Several of the singers said they had originally believed the event would be nonpartisan, only to learn later on that it was being planned and overseen by the president himself.
sentences.zh: 几位歌手表示，他们最初认为该活动将是非党派的，后来才得知它是由总统本人策划和监督的。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由Lexi Diao、Muj Zady、Diana Nguyen和Jack DeSidoro制作。

sentences.zh: 由Rob Zipko编辑，Liz O.提供帮助。

sentences.zh: Bailon，并包含Marion Lozano、Rowan Emisto、Dan Powell、Brad Fisher和Leah Shaw-Dameron的音乐。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly创作。

sentences.zh: 本期节目由Afim Shapiro和Alyssa Moxley进行工程处理。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·博巴尔。

sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.zh: 敬请收听关于如何让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全遮光才能睡觉的人吗？

sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是睡着了就人事不省。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
